prompt:
Write the appraiser's remarks (about 80 words) on a body shop repair estimate after a rear-end collision. Describe the damage seen on the vehicle and the repair plan. No names, dates or amounts. (Internal reference C-1290; do not mention it.) Work these facts into the text naturally, in your own words, without listing them:
- The damage is mostly in line with the described impact.
- The bills show no repeated charges.
- The repair labor hours fit the damage.
- No earlier damage to the vehicle is known.
text: The rear bumper cover is cracked across the center with the lower valance torn free, and the trunk lid shows a crease running toward the left taillight assembly. Most of the visible damage lines up with the impact that was described, and the panel gaps and sensor mounts look consistent with a single rear strike. Labor hours on the proposed repair plan match the work needed to replace the cover, refinish the lid, and recalibrate the parking sensors. The shop billing contains no repeated line items, and nothing in the file points to earlier damage on this vehicle. The plan is to replace the bumper cover and taillight, repair and paint the trunk lid, and reset the sensors.
